name: The Polaris Himalyan Chalet | 3BHK
hostAbout: Hi, I’m Vaishali — mother to a 1.6-year-old bundle of joy, Anavia. I love hosting travelers and sharing the charm of Manali’s mountain life. Between caring for my little one and managing our boutique cottage, I spend too much time spending on things that make memories — good food, cozy corners, and happy guests.

description: Experience the charm of our 3BHK boutique homestay in the serene village of Simsa, just 2 km from Mall Road, Manali. Blending traditional Himachali architecture with modern comforts, this stay offers cozy interiors, spacious rooms, and mountain views. Enjoy evenings in the lush lawn with a BBQ and bonfire under the stars. Perfect for families and groups seeking a peaceful yet convenient getaway close to the heart of Manali. The space The Polaris Collection – The Himalayan Chalet 🌿 The Space Welcome to your private Himalayan getaway. The Polaris Collection offers a peaceful and premium mountain experience with a beautifully designed 3-bedroom chalet. Each room features attached washrooms, quality linens, bed warmers, fresh towels, and essential toiletries. The chalet includes a cozy living area, a warm dining space, and personal balconies overlooking the mountains. Enjoy a relaxed evening in your private lawn, surrounded by nature and fresh mountain air. Our eco-friendly solar water heating ensures a steady supply of hot water throughout your stay. Other things to note 🍽 Meals (Additional Cost) We serve fresh, home-style food on an à la carte basis: • Breakfast • Lunch • Dinner • Snacks Menu is available at the property. BBQ Experience – ₹1200 per session Includes: • BBQ setup • Charcoal • Equipment & utensils • Staff help for setup, marination, grilling & serving Guests must bring their own BBQ food items. Bonfire – ₹1000 per session A cozy outdoor bonfire setup in the private lawn. Additional Notes • Solar heating provides hot water; no backup geysers. • Towels, toiletries, quality linen, and bed warmers are all provided. • Housekeeping available on request.
